title: How to get easy and affordable access to GPUs for AI/ML workloads
description: The growth in AI/ML training, fine tuning, and inference workloads has created exponential demand for GPU capacity, making accelerators a scarce resource. Join this session to learn: How Dynamic Workload Scheduler (DWS) works and how you can use it today * About Compute Engine consumption models, including on-demand, spot, and future reservations *
